title: Akra
description: A significant ancient settlement located in the modern Bannu district of Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. The site, comprising several settlement mounds, is divided by a stream known as the Lohra nullah.

properties.description: Centerpoint of visible mounded area to east of Lohra nullah, found with reference to Magee 2005, Figure 5, page 722. General dates after Magee 2005, page 727.
properties.title: Approximate Location: Akra Area A

properties.description: Centerpoint of visible mounded area to west of Lohra nullah, found with reference to Magee 2005, Figure 5, page 722. General dates after Magee 2005, page 727.
